test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Under which scheme of Airport Authority of India did the Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor inaugurate UMEED Market Place at Srinagar international airport for supporting local art and artisans of Self Help Groups of J&K Rural Livelihood Mission?
solution:
The correct answer is __**AVSAR Scheme**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor inaugurated the **UMEED Market Place** at **Srinagar International Airport **under the **AVSAR Scheme**.
 
• The AVSAR Scheme is an initiative by the **Airport Authority of India** aimed at **supporting local art and artisans**.
